engineering_summary.gateway_power_calculation: IRTrans manual basis: 50 mA per bus-connected module and about 100 mA for Mediacontroller. Segment loads: 0.70 A, 0.70 A, 0.50 A at 12 V; total 1.90 A / 22.8 W. With 20% project load reserve: 2.28 A / 27.36 W. Phoenix 1066704 rating: 12 V / 2.5 A / 30 W.
engineering_summary.ups_recalculation: 24 Vdc raw design current = 16.493 A; with 20% project reserve = 19.792 A. ADEL CBI2420A continuous output = 20 A, so it passes the stated 20% reserve calculation but operates at 98.96% of continuous rating under that conservative design case.
engineering_summary.battery_recalculation: 30 min at 19.792 A = 9.896 Ah ideal; applying additional 20% aging reserve = 11.875 Ah. Selected 24 V battery string = 2 x 12 V 24 Ah, giving about 2.02x the calculated Ah requirement before detailed discharge-curve derating.
engineering_summary.thermal_recalculation: Internal loss basis recalculated to 116.9 W raw and 140.28 W with 20% reserve. ClimaSys NSYCU350DG documented L35-L50 capacity 240 W => 58.45% utilization on this conservative heat-load basis.

gateway_capacity.condenser_rule: Do not consume IRTrans indoor-unit addresses unless HVAC manufacturer topology explicitly requires it.
gateway_capacity.manufacturer_reference_note: IRTrans official page states up to 15 Bus Modules per Mediacontroller; project uses stricter supplier design limit of 12.
gateway_capacity.reserve_policy_note: Gateway capacity is closed at 3 units because the explicit project/supplier rule is 12 indoor units per gateway. The general 20% reserve rule applies to load, I/O, source, UPS and physical space as previously frozen; it is not being extended to gateway endpoint count unless explicitly revised.

dimensioning_recheck.conclusion: Proceed with deterministic real-scale layout. Keep 1200x800x300 if all components, maintenance clearances, cable zones and 20% physical reserve fit. Increase only if the layout fails.
